about: Hand-listed 5d overlay of the slice oracle (tests/overlay_5d.py). Derived once from a live Joern run: the stored S14a CPGs re-queried with the 5d extract.sc. sites = [cs fact id, bundle call-site id, index into rt, type-backed target symbol ids] for every call site with a Joern target that rt does not back; constFacts = the new export-block const facts; constRecords = the bundle constant records they make; selfByJoernNarrowing = call-site ids the self rule confirms although another class of the unit names the method (Joern's own type recovery had already narrowed the site to the enclosing class's method; the strict ast reference does not list them).
